name: ai-billing-audit grader
description: Deterministic LLM-based grader configuration. Guarantees same-input -> same-output reproducibility via temperature=0 and an explicit seed.

enforced_by: temperature=0: fully deterministic greedy decoding (no top-p, top-k, or temperature sampling).

seed=42: provider-side RNG seeded identically on every call so sampling-based ties (extremely rare at temperature=0, but provider implementations may still consult seed for tie-breaking) resolve identically.

response_format=json_schema with strict=true: the provider's constrained decoder rejects any response that does not match the schema byte-for-byte, eliminating any post-hoc resampling or repair logic.

Prompt template is loaded from a versioned file (prompts/grader_prompt.txt) that is committed alongside this config; no string interpolation, timestamp, or thread-ordering fields are included in the rendered prompt.
Grader helper (ai_billing_audit.grader.Grader) resolves model and seed from this config at construction time; no environment-variable overrides are consulted at judge-call time.
reproducibility.verification: Run `python scripts/verify_grader_reproducibility.py` to exercise the grader twice on a fixed sample input and confirm byte-identical output.
reproducibility.non_determinism_audit: Python-side: random.seed(42) is called at grader construction; os.urandom is not consulted; thread-pool ordering is fixed by using a single worker for the deterministic path. LLM-side: see 'enforced_by' above.
